documentation.content:
The daily credit-only roller (FC-078), wired for the covered-call service by FC-100, executed a roll, stranded a buy-to-close, or could not establish what one of its orders did. This is the CC twin of the wheel's policy and watches ONLY covered-call-engine. The operator must KNOW without reading logs.

Conditions:
- call_roll_completed: both legs done, quantities matched. Informational, but it is a two-leg live order pair on the book - look at it the same day.
- call_roll_naked_exposure: the BTC filled and every STO ladder rung failed. Shares UNCOVERED but long-only - NO naked short position. Worst case is the full BTC debit paid in cash with nothing sold against it, re-covered later through the entry path at entry-band premiums, adversely selected.
- call_roll_partial_naked_exposure: the STO filled FEWER contracts than the BTC closed. The difference is uncovered shares. Fields report both legs' qty and price explicitly; net_credit_on_replaced covers only the replaced quantity.
- call_roll_unknown_disposition / call_roll_stc_disposition_unknown: ACT ON THIS ONE. A cancel did not settle to a terminal status, so the bot does not know whether an order filled and deliberately stopped touching the position. An order may still be working. Check the Alpaca account (PA37XLNWDLB3) directly before the next 15:30 cycle.
- call_roll_execution_error: an exception escaped execute_roll. It may have left a filled BTC behind - same weight as naked exposure.
- call_roll_order_refetch_failed: order reads were failing during a poll. Usually transient; if it precedes an unknown-disposition event it is the cause.
- roll_cycle_error: the /roll handler itself raised (deploy/cloud_run_server.py). The whole cycle died - positions after the failure were never evaluated.
- roll_position_error: one position's evaluate or execute raised. Per-position isolation kept the cycle alive; the position it names got no roll and, if it raised out of execute_roll, may have a filled BTC behind it.

Triage (every command names covered-call-engine - do NOT reach for the wheel's service or dataset):
1. gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="covered-call-engine" AND (jsonPayload.event_type=~"^(call_roll_|roll_cycle_|roll_position_)" OR jsonPayload.event=~"^roll_cycle_" OR textPayload:"call_roll_" OR textPayload:"roll_cycle_")' --limit=20 --freshness=1d
   The `jsonPayload.event=~"^roll_cycle_"` clause is LOAD-BEARING, not redundant: `roll_cycle_started` and `roll_cycle_completed` go through `log_system_event`, which passes the name as the structlog MESSAGE (`logger.info(event_type, ...)`, src/utils/logging_events.py:270-271), so those two records land under `jsonPayload.event` and carry NO `event_type` field at all. An event_type-only filter returns every `call_roll_*` row and ZERO cycle rows - which is exactly the pair you need to tell a completed cycle from a cut one. (`roll_cycle_error` and `roll_position_error` DO carry `event_type`; they are logged directly, not through `log_system_event`.)
2. Completed roll: confirm both fills in covered_call.trades_from_activities after the next cc-activities-ingest run (:07 hourly); NO residual open order on either leg's symbol. Assert new strike > old, new strike >= Alpaca avg_entry_price, fill credit = STO fill - BTC fill >= 0 (before fees; two legs of OCC/regulatory fees are about $0.10/contract).
3. Uncovered shares (either flavour): confirm the next /scan -> /run re-covered. If the span gate holds it uncovered through earnings, that is correct by doctrine - record it, do not override.
4. Unknown disposition: reconcile open orders and positions by hand. Do not re-trigger /roll until the account matches expectations.
5. Cycle or position error: read the exception, then decide whether to pause the job before 15:30 tomorrow.

Stop the CC roller without a deploy: gcloud run services update covered-call-engine --region=us-central1 --update-env-vars ROLLER_ENABLED=false (never --set-env-vars; it wipes the whole env set, and the next merge wipes this override anyway - the durable off is `rolling.enabled: false` in config/covered_call.yaml).

Pause the schedule instead (survives deploys, instant): gcloud scheduler jobs pause cc-roll-daily --location us-central1.

NOTE: the filter deliberately does NOT constrain severity. Cloud Run captures the app's stderr as plain text with EMPTY severity, so a severity>=WARNING clause matches nothing (FC-030 fire drill, 2026-07-18). Payload shape is matched both ways.

NOTE: a cut cycle (Cloud Run timeout) does NOT stall the ladder. The orphaned thread keeps running under CPU throttling - on 2026-08-13 an orphaned /scan thread emitted for ten minutes with no request in flight - so its terminals and call_roll_naked_exposure still fire if the instance lives. What is lost is the scheduler's view (a silent 504) and the /roll response; the dangerous residual is instance scale-in mid-ladder. The signature to look for is a roll_cycle_started with no roll_cycle_completed (query 1 above, via the jsonPayload.event clause).

NOTE: this policy is the CC roll path's ONLY detective layer. /regression's log checks are hardcoded to the wheel's service name and filter a severity never emitted (FC-111), and a scheduler 504 from a cut cycle is watched by nothing (FC-107/FC-108).

Rate limit is 300s, not the 86400s used elsewhere: a second roll on the same day is a separate event the operator must see.

Plan: docs/plans/fc-100.md (wiring); docs/plans/fc-078.md (the roller)

conditions.displayName: CC roll executed, failed, or disposition unknown

conditionMatchedLog.filter: (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="covered-call-engine" AND (jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_completed" OR textPayload:"call_roll_completed")) OR (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="covered-call-engine" AND (jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_naked_exposure" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_naked_exposure" OR jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_partial_naked_exposure" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_partial_naked_exposure" OR textPayload:"call_roll_naked_exposure" OR textPayload:"call_roll_partial_naked_exposure")) OR (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="covered-call-engine" AND (jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_unknown_disposition" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_unknown_disposition" OR jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_stc_disposition_unknown" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_stc_disposition_unknown" OR textPayload:"call_roll_unknown_disposition" OR textPayload:"call_roll_stc_disposition_unknown")) OR (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="covered-call-engine" AND (jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_execution_error" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_execution_error" OR jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_order_refetch_failed" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_order_refetch_failed" OR jsonPayload.error_type="roll_cycle_error" OR jsonPayload.event_type="roll_cycle_error" OR jsonPayload.error_type="roll_position_error" OR jsonPayload.event_type="roll_position_error" OR textPayload:"call_roll_execution_error" OR textPayload:"call_roll_order_refetch_failed" OR textPayload:"roll_cycle_error" OR textPayload:"roll_position_error"))
